english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[front]_

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Schedules 2, 3 and 4 to the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001 for requirements as to size, shape, character and arrangement of registration marks, numbers and letters.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(iv) Becomes applicable to a "roadside deposit" with effect from 01/02/2011. - S.I. 2010/2721 refers
